title: 第1章 一枚残缺的灵气丹第2章 缘分已尽
slug: 真心待你反被弃转娶圣女你悔啥
lines: read2（）;辰南默默付出三年，帮林轻眉成为了紫薇圣地的圣女。
林轻眉兴奋的说要送他一件礼物，结果只是一枚残缺的灵气丹。
“你先服用，等我变强了再给你买好的。”
可辰南转头便听说她给白月光萧天麟送了一枚价值万金的圣丹。
辰南看了眼手中的灵气丹，突然笑出了声。
当林轻眉得知消息泄露后，一脸焦急的找了过来。
“辰南，你听我解释！萧家是圣地三大主脉之一，我是为了拉拢萧家，和他们打好关系，我明天就给你买丹药！”
可她的承诺就像是一张白纸，轻轻一捅便破了。
辰南拿出和离书，放在她的面前。
“签了吧！”
望着面前的和离书，林轻眉的声音拔高，尖锐刺耳。
“你是不是脑子有病啊？我都说了那是为了拉拢萧家！你在这里吃什么醋？等我变强了，你不就可以吃香喝辣的？”
“和离书？你吓唬谁呢！你以为你还是辰家少主吗？没有我，你能有今天？”
“我告诉你，别给脸不要脸，赶紧去澄清此事，再向天麟圣子赔礼道歉，不然我就真的跟你和离！”
说罢，不等辰南开口，林轻眉便是气冲冲的离去。
望着面前的和离书，辰南闭上了眼睛。
三年道侣，他真的累了。
“萧天麟！”
一想到林轻眉的白月光，辰南便忍不住冷笑。
萧天麟是萧家少主，也是紫薇圣地的第三圣子，看似天赋异禀，实际上是个银样镴枪头。
辰家与萧家乃是死对头，若不是三年前他父亲在神魔大战中牺牲，萧家一辈子都别想出头。
最好笑的是萧天麟一直被辰南压着打，小时候见到他都会被吓得尿裤子。
如今却成为了林轻眉巴结的对象。
辰南这个辛辛苦苦帮她成为圣女的人，却被她随意一枚灵气丹打发了。
辰南心累了。
他取出了一张传讯符。
“圣主，我想回来了！”
传讯符那头喜出望外。
“辰南，你终于想通了？”
“太好了，我和小婵一直都在等你，无论是圣子之位，还是圣丹圣法，我都会为你准备好。”
一切谈妥，辰南望着手中的和离书。
林轻眉大概忘了，三年前结为道侣时他们有过约定。
如果有一天不爱了，谁都可以随时离开。
犹记得林轻眉当时挽着自己的手臂撒娇。

read2();Chen Nan worked silently for three years and helped Lin Qingmei become a saint of Ziwei Holy Land.
Lin Qingmei excitedly said she wanted to give him a gift, but it turned out to be just a incomplete spiritual energy pill.
"You take it first, and I will buy it for you when I get stronger."
But Chen Nan turned around and heard that she had given Bai Yueguang Xiao Tianlin a holy elixir worth ten thousand gold.
Chen Nan glanced at the spiritual energy pill in his hand and suddenly laughed.
When Lin Qingmei learned that the news was leaked, she came over anxiously.
"Chen Nan, listen to my explanation! The Xiao family is one of the three main lines of the Holy Land. I am here to win over the Xiao family and build a good relationship with them. I will buy you pills tomorrow!"
But her promise is like a piece of white paper that breaks with just a prick.
Chen Nan took out the He Li book and placed it in front of her.
"Sign it!"
Looking at He Lishu in front of him, Lin Qingmei's voice was high-pitched and sharp.
"Are you mentally ill? I told you it was just to win over the Xiao family! Why are you jealous here? When I become stronger, won't you be able to enjoy the good things?"
"He Lishu? Who are you trying to scare? Do you think you are still the young master of the Chen family? Without me, how could you be today?"
"I'm telling you, don't be shameless, go and clarify this matter quickly, and then apologize to Holy Son Tianlin, otherwise I will really make peace with you!"
After saying that, before Chen Nan could speak, Lin Qingmei left angrily.
Looking at He Lishu in front of him, Chen Nan closed his eyes.
After three years as a Taoist monk, he was really tired.
"Xiao Tianlin!"
When thinking of Lin Qingmei's white moonlight, Chen Nan couldn't help but sneer.
Xiao Tianlin is the young master of the Xiao family and the third holy son of Ziwei Holy Land. He seems to be gifted, but in fact he is a silver pewter spear head.
The Chen family and the Xiao family are sworn enemies. If his father hadn't died in the war between gods and demons three years ago, the Xiao family would have never been able to get ahead in their lives.
The funniest thing is that Xiao Tianlin has been pressed down and beaten by Chen Nan. When he was a child, he would be so scared that he wet his pants.
Now she has become the target of Lin Qingmei's fawning.
Chen Nan, who worked so hard to help her become a saint, was dismissed by her random spiritual energy pill.
Chen Nan felt tired.
He took out a communication charm.
"Holy Lord, I want to come back!"
The messenger on the other end was overjoyed.
"Chen Nan, have you finally figured it out?"
"Great, Xiaochan and I have been waiting for you. Whether it is the position of the Holy Son or the Holy Pill and the Holy Law, I will be ready for you."
After everything was settled, Chen Nan looked at the He Li Shu in his hand.
Lin Qingmei probably forgot that they had an agreement when they became Taoist couples three years ago.
If one day we no longer love you, you can leave at any time.
I still remember Lin Qingmei holding her arm and acting coquettishly.
